snippet.title: The Fairly OddParents: Wishology Trilogy: Chapter 1 - Chosen One Gameplay
snippet.description:
Thanks to Marvel Max for commenting this request. This is something I've been wanting to post on this channel. This was another Fairly OddParents flash game where Timmy would crack a code to be what I remember, "The Chosen One". Like in a TV special, Timmy picked up his guitar and started rocking the hell out of it. I remember the special pretty well.

Platforms:
BlueMaxima's Flashpoint
NuMuKi Browser
------------------------------
By Bandicam Screen Recorder (https://www.bandicam.com)
